notes.title: First Day Patch is Here!
notes.content:
Thank you so much for being some of the first people that ever experienced the Bumper Tanks!

On our first day we have made several improvements on the gameplay;

- Visual Effect Improvements 
- Performance Improvements
- Fixed the wall bug on To3 (3 people arena)
- New Floor Breaking Design

Your feedback and recommendations are critical for us to improve this game. 

Please join our discord to reach out directly to the developers;

https://discord.gg/nkzzuVA787

We are also excited to be working on our future development roadmap and hoping to realize them a lot sooner than expected!
